args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (Central, UTC-5). You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The guard was still on the clipboard when Mateo posted at 11:03 that kiosk 1 was back. He said the guard then checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07. So the clipboard period ran about 25 minutes, from 10:42 to roughly 11:07.

The channel doesn't say when the guard stopped using the clipboard. It also doesn't say whether kiosk 2 came back before 11:07.

Gideon: two corrections to my last message. First, the channel doesn't state a timezone for the 3 Aug times, so ignore my "Central, UTC-5". 10:42 AM is the time as shown in Slack. Second, I shouldn't have said the guard was still on the clipboard at 11:03. The channel only says the guard checked in trailer 8836 after kiosk 1 came back at 11:03. The "about 25 minutes" is my own estimate from your first report to your 11:07 all-clear.

Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. That is the time Slack shows, and the channel doesn't give a timezone.

I posted this in the thread. My first message wrongly said "Central, UTC-5" and said the guard was still on the clipboard at 11:03, so I posted a correction. The version above is the accurate one.
